$comment: The v1 setting intents, as ONE list both languages read (myne-md/myne#850 task 4). The settings index that DECIDES a setting's agent-writability is TypeScript and the intent table that ENFORCES it is Rust, so neither side can compare itself with the other from inside one language: a Rust test would compare the table with itself and a TS test the index with itself. This file is the third thing, so a family added on one side alone fails on that side rather than shipping as a setting the agent is offered and cannot spell, or one it can spell and is never offered. Both halves assert BOTH directions, so a stale entry is as loud as a missing one.
